description: This file defines the NotificationsBadgeController class which manages the notifications badge on a Toolbar menu item in an Android app. It handles setting the badge count, visibility, and click actions.

classes.name: NotificationsBadgeController
classes.description: Controller class for managing the notifications badge in a Toolbar menu item.

methods.name: setCount
methods.description: Updates the badge's visibility and displayed count based on the provided count value.

methods.name: setOnClickListener
methods.description: Sets a click listener for the badge's action view.

methods.name: inflateActionView
methods.description: Private helper method to inflate the badge's layout view.
